allYearSelection.materialRowPolicy: non-index thesis, non-zero gas target, or explicit index-to-cash allocation change

contract.fallback: Unallocated deployable capital is routed to the configured VOO/QQQM target-weight index basket; the broker cash buffer remains uninvested.
contract.selectionPolicy: No independent all-year optimization. The artifact freezes the exact Summer/Winter material-row selector into its own ledger.
contract.signalTiming: Component source rows keep their source-lane signal timing. Prior holdings earn close-to-open returns; selected current targets earn adjusted-open-to-close returns.
contract.overfitControl: All-year return-based eligibility mechanically excludes component holdout rows by using one chronological calendar-wide train/validation prefix ending before the earliest component holdout. Those historical splits are development-contaminated rather than pristine. Public holdout reporting begins only at the latest component holdout and is reporting-only; only evidence collected under the prospective validation-integrity seal can satisfy the live evidence gate.

summer.contract: NG=F signal features with Yahoo UNG ETF P&L

execution.priceConvention: Yahoo daily split-and-distribution-adjusted open and close
execution.initialState: already invested in the configured VOO/QQQM fallback at the prior close
execution.turnoverConvention: absolute signed pre-trade weight to target weight, summed across UNG, VOO, and QQQM
execution.benchmarkConvention: gross 80/20 VOO/QQQM daily target-weight close-to-close return
execution.selectionRule: cost and execution parameters are frozen before candidate evaluation and must never be optimized for return
execution.costCalibration: aggregate all-in research allowances; replace only with a separately versioned calibration built from stored historical quotes and fills

baseline.borrowBasis: default live routing opens UNG shorts only when Alpaca reports easy-to-borrow status

overnightRisk.behavior: Retain the complete prior-close UNG position overnight; execute the next causal target at the adjusted session open.
overnightRisk.holdoutUse: The 2025+ retrospective period is descriptive only and cannot change a policy recommendation or all-year eligibility.

selected.sourceSetLabel: NGAS Summer Alpha + NGAS Winter Alpha
selected.rowSelectionPolicy: For each entry date, pick the material Summer Alpha row, else the material Winter Alpha row, else the shared index-fallback target. The all-year ledger then recomputes every executed leg and cost.
selected.materialRowDefinition: A source row is material when it has a non-index thesis, non-zero gas target, or an explicit index-to-cash allocation change. All-year costs are recomputed after target selection.

selectionRealityCheck.method: standalone all-year centered circular block bootstrap
selectionRealityCheck.comparison: all-year beta net daily return minus US index basket daily return

realityCheck.comparison: all-year beta net daily return minus US index basket daily return
